All Military gameplay contracts remain D0034.
philosophy: 城市社会资源、组织能力、经验与人才转化为军事力量；防御、战前准备、扩张及紧急军事化均有价值，不要求和平经济产出来回本。

ability_structure.shared_boundary: Design arrangement, not mandatory runtime schema.

abilities.mechanical_contract: ACTIVE>=2: eligible Encampment district+1 Housing and each eligible actually present ordinary Tier+1 Housing (Tier existence, not weighted D); each actual working military specialist+2 base General GPP, normal multipliers apply. No +15% Combat XP.

base_effects.institution_presentation: Cumulative presentation-only institutions follow Current Identity/Potential; abilities use ACTIVE. Historical entries follow separate Legacy review, never ordinary engine buildings.

unit_eligibility.scope: LAND_COMBAT_UNITS_ONLY; no naval/air expansion; military unit scope does not make civilian units combat units.
unit_eligibility.free_levied_duplicated_captured: INCLUDED only if origin can be confirmed and belongs to this training city; otherwise EXCLUDED. Do not infer provenance merely from current tile or nearest city.
unit_eligibility.technical_boundary: Reliable acquisition attribution remains a technical investigation; no silent eligibility expansion.

unit_training_snapshot.authority: Unit-held permanent per-ability training buff acquired at eligible production/acquisition; not ongoing city linkage.
unit_training_snapshot.qualification: Snapshot current city ACTIVE ability entitlement and applicable ability parameters at grant.
unit_training_snapshot.insight_E: E_birth = actual working Encampment specialist count at grant; fixed in unit buff. Later city specialist changes never recalculate it.
unit_training_snapshot.tradition: Snapshot applicable local Tradition birth-CS and Mentorship/Insight enhancements at grant. Later city Tradition changes do not retroactively upgrade existing units.
unit_training_snapshot.dynamic_inputs: P remains unit actual current promotions at each combat; mentor promotions and current adjacency remain combat facts. Permanent buff does not mean fixed XP award at birth.
unit_training_snapshot.city_independence: Later city ACTIVE loss, building loss, respecialization or city state change does not withdraw/revalue the unit buff; no ongoing source-city lookup.
unit_training_snapshot.formation: For the same Military ability effect retain the maximum among constituent units; never sum/average. Distinct abilities still contribute separately. No single source city is selected as merged-unit XP authority.
unit_training_snapshot.technical_boundary: Upgrade persistence and compound per-ability parameter encoding/merge are to be verified; source city is provenance, not ongoing authority. No unit-owner/conquest Legacy policy inferred.
unit_training_snapshot.scope_clarification: Permanent snapshot contract applies to awarded unit quality/XP training buffs. The local Training Efficiency layer is not a unit-held post-creation benefit; do not apply birth permanence or formation max to city production efficiency.

comprehensive_training.predicate: Quality layer only: at least one actually present completed, unpillaged eligible ordinary Tier1 building in the domain. Shared ontology/unique normalization/free ordinary building rules apply. Bare district, D>0 or Tier2 alone do not substitute.
comprehensive_training.timing: Quality layer: grant permanent unit CS buff at eligible acquisition under Military ACTIVE>=3. Training Efficiency is a separate local training effect within this same ability, not a permanent birth-CS buff.
comprehensive_training.tradeoff: Population/district slots/production invested in broader infrastructure versus producing more troops. +5 is theoretical, not activation minimum.
comprehensive_training.population_example: Encampment plus five domains means six ordinary population-limited districts (16 population under standard slot rules); not a new hard population requirement overriding exemptions.
comprehensive_training.restructuring: Existing T1 infrastructure may qualify immediately after completed respecialization; intended synergy, not an exploit.
comprehensive_training.structure: One named ability, two layers: Breadth → permanent Unit Quality; Depth → local Training Efficiency. No new ability slot.

training_efficiency.scope: Military ACTIVE>=3; improve this city’s military-unit training efficiency using the same five domains. Land combat scope retained; per-class equality and purchase applicability remain expressly unresolved.
training_efficiency.input: Shared_D0028.concepts.DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT; Absolute Infrastructure Depth, not relative completion percentage.
training_efficiency.formula_fact: D(district)=min(10,sum eligible ordinary building Tier weights); Tier1/2/3/4 = 1/2/3/4.
training_efficiency.shared_qualification: Reuse Shared ordinary ontology, completed/unpillaged eligibility, unique replacements/free ordinary buildings, no imputed missing tiers, cap10 and highest-single-district D per domain. No institution/carrier contribution.
training_efficiency.onset: T1-only / D≈1 provides no depth-efficiency benefit; contribution begins around T2-stage / D≈3. This freezes the normal-chain structural relationship, not an executable D>=3 threshold or a completed-chain requirement.
training_efficiency.environment_intent: A complete three-tier chain may provide D6 and substantial efficiency; extra T4 investment may reach D10 and further efficiency. No requirement that fully built districts across Mod environments give equal bonuses.
not_inferred: T1 quality eligibility as an extra depth gate
unresolved: linear versus discrete versus diminishing curve
per-domain conversion then sum versus total D then mapping
same efficiency across military unit classes
exact onset predicate and nonstandard compositions (T2 alone, T3 alone, same-tier multiples); normal-chain examples do not decide these
training_efficiency.boundary: Quality purchase eligibility remains confirmed independently; it must not silently authorize Gold/Faith Training Efficiency. No CS increase above breadth cap5 due to depth.
training_efficiency.technical_boundary: No modifier path, stacking math or implementation authorized; details must be settled before dependent implementation.

development_paths.breadth: Five T1-only domains can reach quality+5 but gain no depth-layer benefit yet; breadth is not efficient mass-training infrastructure.
development_paths.depth: Fewer deeply developed domains yield fewer quality sources but higher training efficiency; e.g. three qualified deep domains retain+3CS.
development_paths.metropolis: Five deep domains can combine high quality and efficiency, at full population/district/building/long-term investment cost; allowed endpoint, not minimum.
development_paths.story: 基础领域提供训练内容；更成熟的科研、文化、工业、商业和宗教组织进一步支撑高效训练。

logistics.preferred_presentation: Dedicated physical support unit line; Production cost and visible1:1 escort/formation relationship.
logistics.effect: For linked combat unit replace covered ongoing strategic-resource maintenance with additional Gold maintenance on logistics unit.
logistics.progression: Versions unlock with new maintenance-resource units and cover own/prior supported resources; exact HD line/unlocks/coverage pending.
logistics.costs: UNSET; early10/laterhundreds-or1000 was discussion expectation, not configured values.
logistics.fallback: UI/UnitAbility logistics contract only for future review if physical escort spike demonstrates material limitations; not adopted.

mentorship.historical_basis: D0008 MIL-010–012 with new same PromotionClass restriction and permanent birth-buff qualification.
mentorship.fighter: Own eligible land combat unit carrying Mentorship entitlement; intermediate units may benefit, not P=0-only.
mentorship.mentor: Adjacent one-hex own eligible land combat unit, same PromotionClass, higher actual promotions; choose maximum P, never sum mentors.
mentorship.tradition: Unit-held enhancement fixed at grant; exact increment pending Balance.
mentorship.xp: Separate bonus XP, not multiplied by normal combat-XP modifiers, not limited by E, no extra artificial cap.
mentorship.scope: Real combat only, local one-hex evaluation, no garrison requirement or empire-wide mentor scan.
mentorship.timing_review: Precise engine combat event/position/promotion snapshot and exceptional combat classification require later technical boundary review; no new garrison ability.

insight.P: Actual promotions at combat, including lawful Corps/Army inheritance; not XP level.
insight.E: Actual working Encampment specialists frozen at grant, not current source-city specialists.
insight.tradition: Unit-held enhancement fixed at grant; exact increment pending Balance.
insight.xp: Independent extra XP; do not override ordinary combat-XP cap. No artificial +3/+4 cap.
insight.evidence: User historical proof reported usually one fewer combat, never two/no faster veteran progression. Historical E<=4 and cap8 were model inputs, not universal new constraints. Current installed HD/cached DB cap32 requires BALANCE_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED; no generic snowball redesign.

military_tradition.action: Great General third action: consume permanently in Military city, no native retire effect; aura/retire remain separate choices.
military_tradition.ownership: Local city historical asset, not national.
military_tradition.tiers: Finite discrete tiers; approximately6 target, not locked count. Each tier strengthens exactly one of birthCS/MentorshipXP/InsightXP; thresholds/order/increments unset.
military_tradition.application: Enhancements assigned to subsequently acquired eligible units as permanent training snapshots; not dynamic city aura or retroactive improvement.
military_tradition.era_requirement: NONE; different-era General requirement not adopted.
military_tradition.legacy: City Tradition respecialization/conquest remains separately deferred; existing awarded unit buffs remain independent.

unified_mobilization.name: 统一动员
unified_mobilization.command_scope: One commander per disconnected eligible domestic Military network, not one global commander. A participant responds only to its own network commander.
unified_mobilization.topology: Use common route/direct/center/distribution qualification; do not flatten domestic roads or arbitrary trade connectivity into membership or allow recursive relay. Precise component representation/split-merge reconciliation is future Architecture review, not permission to reverse route direction.
unified_mobilization.target: Entire normalized upgrade unit line; unique replacements normalize to the corresponding line. Single/Corps/Army are the same target. Not entire PromotionClass. Unmapped/modded line classification requires technical review, never guess from class alone.
unified_mobilization.command_qualification: Current Military identity/eligible effective ACTIVE>=1 and current active production of eligible military unit. Later queue entries do not count.
unified_mobilization.initial: Without commander, first city entering eligible active production becomes commander.
unified_mobilization.takeover: Strictly higher authority takes over; equal authority retains incumbent. Production changes AND relevant ACTIVE changes trigger this check. Newly promoted higher candidate takes over without needing production change.
unified_mobilization.downgrade: Commander downgrade with higher eligible candidate causes takeover/reelection; equal authority alone does not steal.
unified_mobilization.target_change: Incumbent changes between eligible units: retain command, update target.
unified_mobilization.invalidation: Stops eligible production, loses Military qualification/city, respecializes or target invalidates: one bounded election among current network candidates, highest ACTIVE then earliest current continuous eligibility sequence.
unified_mobilization.participant: Any otherwise eligible connected own city regardless of specialization, including ordinary cities; current active unit production must match target line. Source/center self-reception follows common network qualification, no invented free self-reception.
unified_mobilization.effect: Military unit Production efficiency only; no local CS/XP/Tradition/logistics transfer.
unified_mobilization.event_intent: Relevant production/ACTIVE/topology changes update affected state; bounded election on invalidation; no per-frame/per-turn empire reelection.
